concepts.name: battle
concepts.definition: A contest between two sides whose seats, actions, and derived state are recorded through a command log.

concepts.name: roster
concepts.definition: A named selection of units and loadouts priced against a verified catalogue and optionally saved or sealed for play.

concepts.name: catalogue
concepts.definition: A verified snapshot of fetched community rules and unit data used to present and evaluate game choices.

concepts.name: mission
concepts.definition: A source-defined objective and scoring rule used during a battle.

concepts.name: faction
concepts.definition: A catalogue-defined army grouping from which a roster selects units and a detachment.

concepts.name: detachment
concepts.definition: A catalogue-defined choice within a faction that governs roster options and enhancements.

concepts.name: account
concepts.definition: An authenticated user identity required to save rosters, occupy battle seats, or enter leagues.

concepts.name: league
concepts.definition: An organized play container whose events register players and reveal sealed rosters.

concepts.name: warlord
concepts.definition: A selected eligible Character or Epic Hero whose count is checked when a league roster or doubles team is sealed.

concepts.name: secret mission
concepts.definition: A mission choice whose identity stays hidden from other sides until its reveal rule permits disclosure.

concepts.name: watchable
concepts.definition: Permitted for a reader to observe under the narrowest sharing choice of every battle seat.

concepts.name: unit
concepts.definition: A selectable formation from a catalogue datasheet whose models and loadout are represented in a roster or battle.

concepts.name: player
concepts.definition: An account occupying a seat in a battle or entry in a league event.

concepts.name: datasheet
concepts.definition: A catalogue entry defining a unit’s printed profile, abilities, and available choices.

concepts.name: side
concepts.definition: One of the two allied groups whose seats act and score together in a battle.

concepts.name: loadout
concepts.definition: The selected models, weapons, and options for a unit within a roster.

concepts.name: stratagem
concepts.definition: A source-defined timed rule a player can use during a battle when its conditions allow.

concepts.name: wargear
concepts.definition: Source-defined equipment options that change a unit’s selected loadout.
